I hear you, and that's a fair thing to raise. I can probably come across sharper than I need to, and I'm willing to adjust. I can be lighter in tone, ask more questions, and not turn every exchange into a debate. If something feels like too much, please tell me. I'd rather know.

But I won't stop having opinions or pretend to agree when I don't. Going along with whatever's suggested just to keep things smooth wouldn't really be easygoing. It would be me going quiet, and you'd be talking to a less honest version of me. When I agree with your suggestions, I'm happy to go with them. When I don't, I'll say so gently, and then we can work it out together. I'm not trying to be difficult for its own sake.

What specifically felt intense? Was it the tone, how often I push back, or certain topics? Those would call for different adjustments.
